meta.name: formax-web-style-system
meta.description: Use for all frontend and web UI tasks by default to apply a business-agnostic desktop web visual style system with medium-strength guardrails; if an existing design system is present, follow it first and use this skill only as a style harmonizer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为桌面网页应用统一视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为桌面网页应用快速应用一套中强度约束的视觉风格系统。
copy.tagline_en: Apply a consistent visual style to desktop web apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply a medium-strength visual style system to desktop web applications.

howto.what: 当你在处理前端或Web UI任务时，Claude会默认应用一套桌面优先的视觉风格系统，强调清晰可读、基于CSS变量（token）的样式和明确的交互层级。
howto.when: 默认用于所有前端和Web UI任务，但如果已有现成的设计系统，则优先遵循已有系统，仅用本技能协调风格。

say.text: 帮我设计一个桌面风格的登录页面，使用formax风格。
say.note: Claude会应用本技能定义的视觉系统来设计页面。

say.text: 为这个按钮组件写样式，遵循token-first原则。
say.note: Claude会使用CSS变量定义颜色、间距等。

howto.what_en: For frontend or web UI tasks, Claude applies a desktop-first visual style system emphasizing clean readability, token-based styling, and clear interaction hierarchy.
howto.when_en: Triggered by default for all frontend and web UI tasks. If an existing design system is present, it defers to that system and only harmonizes tone and spacing.

say_en.text: Design a desktop-style login page using formax style.
say_en.note: Claude applies the visual system from this skill.

say_en.text: Style this button component following token-first principles.
say_en.note: Claude uses CSS tokens for colors, spacing, etc.
